indication.text: HALAVEN is indicated for the treatment of patients with metastatic breast cancer who have previously received at least two chemotherapeutic regimens for the treatment of metastatic disease, with prior therapy that included an anthracycline and a taxane.

Prior therapy should have included an anthracycline and a taxane in either the adjuvant or metastatic setting.

target_moa.text: Eribulin is a non-taxane microtubule dynamics inhibitor that inhibits tubulin polymerization and microtubule growth (but not shortening), interfering with mitotic spindle formation and causing G2/M cell cycle arrest and block in the prometaphase portion of mitosis.

citations.quote: Halaven Injection (eribulin mesylate) is a new chemical entity that inhibits tubulin polymerization and microtubule dynamics (i.e., inhibition of microtubule growth but not shortening), interfering with normal mitotic spindle formation resulting in blocks within the prometaphase portion of mitosis.
Eribulin mesylate induces G2/M cell cycle arrest but does not affect progression through the G1 or S cell cycle phases or the G1/S cell cycle transition point.
HALAVEN (eribulin mesylate) Injection is a non-taxane microtubule dynamics inhibitor.

modality.text: Small molecule (synthetic analogue of halichondrin B)

citations.quote: Eribulin mesylate is a synthetic analogue of halichondrin B, a product isolated from the marine sponge *Halichondria okadai*.

Most serious adverse reactions were febrile neutropenia (4%) and neutropenia (2%); peripheral neuropathy was the most common cause of discontinuation (5%).
